name: VisFactor
intro: VisFactor 是面向多模态大模型基础视觉认知能力的诊断基准，将 FRCT 中20个视觉子测验数字化，覆盖4个认知领域和10个因素。固定集含808题、3,046个查询，其中12个子测验支持可控难度的参数化无限生成。
org: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shanghai AI Laboratory, Tencent AI Lab, Nanyang Technological U
metric: 任务特定准确率或精确匹配；总分为20个子测验分数的算术平均
modality: 图像, 文本, 多模态
task_type: 视觉推理, 图像问答
scale: 20个子测验；固定集808题/3,046个查询；其中12个支持无限参数化生成
intro_en: VisFactor is a diagnostic benchmark for foundational visual cognition in MLLMs. It digitizes 20 vision-centric FRCT subtests spanning four cognitive domains and ten factors. The fixed set contains 808 questions and 3,046 queries, while 12 subtests support unlimited difficulty-controlled parametric generation.
scale_en: 20 subtests; 808 questions / 3,046 queries; 12 support unlimited parametric generation
metric_en: Task-specific accuracy or exact match; arithmetic mean of the 20 subtest scores

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2502.16435v4, Section 2.2 (pp.4-5), Appendices A.1-A.2, and Appendix D. Counts are pinned to v4: 39 evaluated models. Only 12 of 20 subtests support parametric unlimited generation.. VisFactor starts from 72 FRCT subtests, removes four drawing and three speech tasks, then removes 45 text-only tasks to retain 20 visual subtests spanning ten factors. GPT-4o and Gemini-2.5-Flash rewrite instructions independently, humans reconcile them with the manual, 300-dpi scans are cropped, and answer keys are copied verbatim. The fixed set has 808 questions and 3,046 queries. A separate algorithmic pipeline generates and validates difficulty-controlled instances for 12 subtests. Appendix A.2 applies direct normalization, decomposed five-option queries, grouped consistency, symmetry variants, and specialized SS3/VZ3 scoring before averaging the 20 subtest scores.
